create_average_policy_agent: create an AveragePolicy agent with a best-response RL agent, neural network config, and reservoir buffer for learning average policies
run_fictitious_play_iteration: run an AverageNetworkFictitiousPlay iteration that collects best-response samples, trains average policies, and updates the mean-field distribution
train_average_network: train the average policy network by sampling transitions from a reservoir buffer and minimizing categorical cross-entropy loss
build_mfg_game_solver: build a mean-field game solver using Deep Average-network Fictitious Play with multiple players and best-response RL agents
evaluate_average_policy: evaluate the average policy network by computing action probabilities from info states and legal action masks
